description: The bar chart titled “Factual Errors” illustrates the number of factual errors across four QA datasets for three QA methods. The horizontal axis contains the category labels HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC (left to right), and the vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. Each dataset shows a grouped set of three vertical bars corresponding to the legend: “NoR QA” (orange with a crosshatch pattern), “OneR QA” (red with a dotted pattern), and “IRCoT QA” (dark blue with diagonal stripes), with numeric values annotated above each bar. For HotpotQA, the bars are approximately 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCoT QA); for 2WikiMQA, they are about 29 (NoR QA), 23 (OneR QA), and 14 (IRCoT QA); for MuSiQue, they are about 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA); and for IIRC, they are about 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). The bars are arranged in consistent left-to-right order within each group matching the legend, the dataset groups are not shown as sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors/patterns and the value annotations.
